_comment: Dynamic config for signal_scorer. Edit keywords here — no code changes needed. Used IDENTICALLY by training and prediction so features always match.
_version_note: 2.1 = exogenous-shock extension: natural disasters (tsunami/earthquake), terror attacks, and armed invasions/conflict, each with its COUNTERACTION captured (disaster -> initial risk-off, then repatriation/emergency-relief reversal e.g. USD_JPY yen back up; invasion -> escalation, then ceasefire de-escalation). Keywords are DB-grounded on unified_feed and use specific multi-word phrases to avoid the metaphorical noise found there ('cultural invasion', 'gravytsunami' handle, economic 'recovery/relief', bare 'ied'). 2.0 = era extension for 2016-2026 back-simulation (45th/46th/47th presidencies): crypto policy, COVID/public health, QE/zero-rate, NK crisis, 2018 trade war vocabulary.
_geo_terms_note: DIRECTION AUDIT: geopolitical_terms feeds hawkish_risk_score, so it may contain ONLY escalatory/war-direction words. Peace-direction words (ceasefire, summit, denuclearization) live in flag_peace_deescalation; macro-domain words (pandemic, stimulus, inflation, bailout...) live in their domain flags feeding macro_risk_score — putting them here inflated hawkish for COVID/Fed posts (wrong direction).
_country_note: SPEAKER x SUBJECT. A country word means different things depending on who says it: the Chinese Embassy posting about China is routine self-promotion ('a herder helped a stuck car in Xinjiang' was scoring USD_CNY -0.30%); the US President posting about China is cross-border friction. When EVERY country a post mentions is the SPEAKER'S OWN and no policy flag fired, raw_score is multiplied by country_self_damp. A post naming a FOREIGN country is left alone. country_policy_guard: flags that make a post market-moving even when self-referential (a Chinese official announcing retaliation tariffs is NOT routine), so the damp never fires on them.

flag_peace_deescalation: war can finally come to an end
policy_flags._event_flags_note: EXOGENOUS SHOCKS (v2.1). Multi-word/specific keywords ONLY — unified_feed showed bare words are noisy: 'invasion' -> 'cultural invasion', 'tsunami' -> '@gravytsunami'/'National Preparedness Month', 'kidnap' -> local news, 'ied' -> 4577 false hits, 'relief/recovery' -> economic. Disaster+terror route to macro_risk_score (risk-off/safe-haven, non-trade-war); armed_conflict routes to hawkish_risk_score (war escalation). The COUNTERACTION is captured by flag_stimulus (emergency relief/repatriation/reconstruction = the reversal, e.g. yen back up) and flag_peace_deescalation (ceasefire = conflict reversal).

_endorsement_note: Political endorsement / ceremonial posts. They are stuffed with policy buzzwords (Crime, Borders, Military, Tax Cuts, 2nd Amendment) so score_policy rates them highly and they slip through the 0.3 weight filter into training, the embedding cache and the Gemma analyst run. Matching ANY pattern zeroes raw_score at SCORING time - upstream of build, training and analyst generation. NOTE: bare 'great honor' / 'congratulations to' are TOO GREEDY (they appear in real market news: 'Great Honor to announce our Trade Agreement with Indonesia'); only endorsement-specific forms belong here.
_norm_note: norm_divisors: max values from training data, used to normalize single-post composites.
